AMERICAN MODERN LLOYDS INSURANCE COMPANY 
RIDERS CHOICE PROGRAM 
EXPLANATORY MEMORANDUM 
TEXAS 
 
American Modern Lloyds Insurance Company is pleased to submit revisions to our Riders Choice 
Program. All revisions are listed below and have been highlighted on the manual pages for your 
convenience.  We are requesting a new business effective date of 12/02/2014 and renewal business 
date of 12/24/2014.

 Sub Class Relativity  
• Please see revisions to   
• 
Class A, Sub Class SD (Comp, Coll, UM, UMPD)  
• 
Class B, Sub Class CR (Comp, UM, UMPD)  
• 
Class B, Sub Class SD (Comp, Coll)  
• 
Class C, Sub Class CR (MP, PIP, UM, UMPD)  
• 
Class D, Sub Class AS (UM, UMPD)  
• The decimals for all factors have been increased to three places for our system requirements.  
 
 Increased Limits Relativity  
• Liability Limit UM factor changes for 50/100 and 250/500.  
• Revised title from Liability Limit to Property Damage Limit for second set of factors.   
• The decimals for all factors have been increased to three places for our system requirements.   
 
Homeowner Discount Factors  
• All factors have been revised to 10%.  
  
Loss Free Renewal Discount Factors  
• The Second and Additional Renewal factors have been revised to 5%.   
  
To the best of our knowledge and belief, this filing is in compliance with the statutes and regulations of 
your state.  
  
Thank you for your time and consideration of this submission.
